hero.title: Obstetrics, Gynaecology & Fertility Specialist
hero.qualifications: MBBS, MS (Obstetrics & Gynaecology) · Cosmetic Gynaecologist (Laser) · Infertility Specialist

biography: Dr Chitra Soni cares for women through every stage of health: normal and painless delivery, caesarean section, high-risk pregnancy, laparoscopic gynaecological surgery (hysterectomy, myomectomy, ovarian cyst), diagnostic and operative hysteroscopy, infertility treatment and laser cosmetic gynaecology. She is known for listening, explaining clearly and treating each patient with warmth.
clinicalPhilosophy: Every patient deserves compassionate care, clear communication, and the most effective, least invasive treatment plan available.
